content: SQLite has no native TTL. Established cache pattern: store expires_at as INTEGER unix ms; filter on read (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now); delete expired rows via periodic/sweep job (sweep on open matches this repo postgres provider precedent); upsert via INSERT ON CONFLICT(cache_key) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value, expires_at=excluded.expires_at; partial index on expires_at WHERE expires_at IS NOT NULL. Community implementations (gist SQLite-as-cache, jkelin/cache-sqlite-lru-ttl) confirm the shape; lazy-expiry-on-read alone leaves tombstones, sweep reclaims them.
